topics.name: Claude
key_changes: Improved code generation with vision capability
Better structured output and JSON mode

java_relevance.developer_summary: Claude 3.5 Sonnet excels at code generation and Java refactoring. Use for Spring Boot scaffolding, build system configuration, and complex algorithm explanation.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Suitable for system design review, architecture documentation generation, and infrastructure-as-code planning. Extended context enables full codebase analysis.

topics.name: ChatGPT
key_changes: Supports advanced file uploads (PDFs, images, videos)
GPT-4o mini variant for cost-effective usage

java_relevance.developer_summary: GPT-4o provides strong Java code generation and debugging. Useful for legacy code modernization and Hibernate/JPA query optimization.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Can review architectural patterns and provide cloud migration guidance. Consider API costs when integrating into Java applications at scale.

topics.name: Elasticsearch
key_changes: Enhanced security with API key rotation

java_relevance.developer_summary: Elasticsearch 8.14 offers excellent Java integration via Elasticsearch Java API Client. Strong support for vector embeddings and semantic search in Java applications.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Vector search capabilities align with AI/LLM integration patterns. Monitor ESQL for analytics queries. Plan for data synchronization strategy in microservices.

java_relevance.developer_summary: Use Fabric8 Kubernetes Java client for operator development. Spring Cloud Kubernetes enables service discovery and config server integration.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Plan Java workload resource requests/limits carefully. Use Java-specific metrics exporters (Micrometer + Prometheus) for pod observability. Consider GraalVM native images for faster startup.

topics.name: AWS
key_changes: AWS Lambda now supports Java 23 runtime
Enhanced VPC Lattice for service mesh
New cost optimization tools for Java workloads
deprecations: Elastic Beanstalk legacy Docker support deprecated

java_relevance.developer_summary: AWS SDK for Java v2.x is the standard; avoid v1.x. Use AWS Corretto for optimized JDK builds. Spring Cloud AWS simplifies bean integration.
java_relevance.architect_summary: ECS/EKS for containerized Java. RDS Aurora supports failover for JDBC connections. Use DynamoDB for serverless workloads. Plan for eventual consistency in distributed Java apps.

topics.name: JDK (Java Development Kit)
deprecations: JDK 19-22 are non-LTS; use 21 LTS for production

java_relevance.developer_summary: JDK 23 (non-LTS) introduces virtual threads for high-throughput servers. JDK 21 LTS (2023) is current stable for production. Consider gradual upgrade path.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Virtual threads reduce need for reactive frameworks. Use for I/O-bound services (database access, HTTP calls). Monitor GC behavior; ZGC is production-ready. Plan multi-release JAR strategy for backwards compatibility.

topics.name: Spring Boot
key_changes: Spring AI module with Claude/GPT/Gemini integrations
Virtual thread support for async handlers
Enhanced metrics for database connection pools

java_relevance.developer_summary: Spring Boot 3.3+ targets JDK 17+. Spring AI enables LLM integration patterns. Use Spring Data for data access; embrace Spring Cloud for distributed systems.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Spring Cloud ecosystem (Config, Discovery, Gateway) supports microservices. Spring Security 6 uses lambda-based DSL. Plan for cloud-native observability (logs, metrics, traces).

topics.name: GraalVM
key_changes: Better IDE integration for native image builds

java_relevance.developer_summary: GraalVM Native Image reduces cold-start time for serverless/container workloads from seconds to milliseconds. Build-time reflection config required.
java_relevance.architect_summary: Ideal for AWS Lambda, Kubernetes, microservices. Trade-off: longer build times vs faster runtime. Use Spring Native or Quarkus for easier native builds. Monitor binary size growth.
